I'm not interested, because blowback in AR format is a bad idea. If wanted an AR in 9mm, I would buy one from Bazooka Brothers. Now that Olympic is no more (and their OoB fire issues are gone with them), they switched to reselling RMWXtreme, which is excellent. Supports .45 Auto with no issues, too! Or, if I needed a blowback 9mm, I would choose from dedicated designs such as CZ Scorpion, SIG MPX, or heck, even JRC. And then there's SUB-2000, which is plain better at PCC than AR-based PCCs, unless you want AR ergos.

Note 1. MPX comes very close to AR-9 in format, but they make the whole thing workable by using the above the barrel area, like on Walther MPL.

Note 2. I do remember about Vector Uzis, but the ergos aren't there IMHO. Not better than AR-9. Maybe more reliable. Okay, there's also MP-5 clone by Zenith, which is a pretty good deal.
